name: Kiryu
source:
Ryu - Dragon

Weakness: Living by other's rules

"You should be happy to have me for your partner."

Kiryu forces you into making the agreement with him. The aloof loner doesn't follow anybody, but there's another side to him. A side that he shows you, and only you...

"A look at the Ryu clan head's bare skin doesn't come for free."

Miyabi: "I admit that he's powerful, but I'm sick of that smug attitude of his. I don't know if it's because of his noble lineage or what."
Yukinojo: "I know little about him myself, but I understand that he has a strained relationship with his clan. He's an enigmatic man..."

[From [url=https://voltageapps.com/love365/apps/enchanted-in-the-moonlight/]English official site[/url]]
